cases.text: This week brings a significant new customer win with Northwind Retail, an early delivery for Contoso, and celebrations across the team.
Priya Shah and Tom Evans signed Northwind Retail to a three-year managed service contract on 22 September, worth about 180 thousand pounds a year, with onboarding starting in October.
The Contoso migration went live on 20 September, two days early, and the Contoso team finished user training on 24 September.
Welcome to Lucy Grey, who joined the service desk on 29 September.
Thank you to Sam Patel for covering the service desk over the bank holiday weekend.
Litware Supplies will raise the price of its business laptops by 5 per cent from 1 November, but orders placed before 31 October will keep the current price.
Happy birthday to Dan Wood, who celebrated on 2 October.
Congratulations to Tom Evans on the arrival of his daughter Ava on 25 September.
This week brings a record-breaking new customer win with Northwind Retail, an early delivery for Contoso, and celebrations across the team.
Priya Shah and Tom Evans signed Northwind Retail to a three-year managed service contract on 22 September, worth about 280 thousand pounds a year, with onboarding starting in October.
The Contoso migration went live on 20 September, two days early, and the Contoso team finished user training on 24 September, saving the customer thousands of pounds.
From 1 December 2026, Fabrikam Networks will add surcharges to Gen 4 Branch and Campus and Data Centre hardware and increase Gen 5 hardware list prices.
